verdict.rationale: Baseten ships the official open-source Truss SDK/CLI for packaging and deploying models (github.com/basetenlabs/truss) and also exposes OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic Messages-compatible endpoints so developers can use those official client SDKs (and LangChain) directly against Baseten (baseten-docs-21, baseten-docs-33, baseten-gh-1/2/5/6). This gives AI-native users multiple first-party and compatible SDK paths for building agentic workflows. Missing for 10: a dedicated first-party 'Baseten Python client' distinct from Truss, and independent/hands-on corroboration of SDK reliability beyond docs and repo README.
